sn12.35:1.4: evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotīti || || 3
sn12.35:1.6: Katamaṃ nu kho bhante jarāmaraṇaṃ || kassa ca panidam jarāmaraṇanti || ||
sn12.35:1.7: No kallo pañhoti Bhagavā avoca || || Katamaṃ jarāmaraṇaṃ kassa ca panidam jarāmaraṇanti iti vā bhikkhu yo vadeyya || aññaṃ jarāmaraṇam aññassa ca panidaṃ jarāmaraṇanti iti vā bhikkhu yo vadeyya || ubhayam etam ekattam vyañjanam eva nānaṃ || ||
sn12.35:1.8: Tam jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti vā bhikkhu diṭṭhiyā sati brahmacariyavāso na hoti ||
sn12.35:1.9: aññaṃ jīvam aññaṃ sarīranti vā bhikkhu diṭṭhiyā sati brahmacariyavāso na hoti || ||
sn12.35:1.10: Ete te bhikkhu ubho ante anupagamma majjhena Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti || ||
sn12.35:2.1: Katamā nu kho bhante jāti kassa ca panāyaṃ jātīti || ||
sn12.35:2.2: No kallo pañho ti Bhagavā avoca || || Katamā jāti kassa ca panāyaṃ jātīti iti vā bhikkhu yo vadeyya || aññā jāti aññassa ca panāyaṃ jātīti iti vā bhikkhu yo vadeyya || ubhayam etam ekattam vyañjanam eva nānaṃ || ||
sn12.35:2.3: Taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīrantivā bhikkhu diṭṭhiyā sati brahmacariyavāso na hoti ||
sn12.35:2.4: aññaṃ jīvam aññaṃ sarīranti vā bhikkhu diṭṭhiyā brahmacariyavāso na hoti || ||
sn12.35:2.5: Ete te bhikkhu ubho ante anupagamma majjhena Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti || ||
sn12.35:3.1: Katamo nu kho bhante bhavo kassa ca panāyam bhavoti || ||
sn12.35:3.2: No kallo pañhoti Bhagavā avoca || || Katamo bhavo kassa ca panāyam bhavoti iti vā bhikkhu yo vadeyya || añño bhavo aññassa ca panāyam bhavoti iti vā bhikkhu yo vadeyya || ubhayam etam ekattam vyañjanam eva nānam || ||
sn12.35:3.3: Tam jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti vā bhikkhu diṭṭhiyā sati brahmacariyavāso na hoti ||
sn12.35:3.4: aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti vā bhikkhu diṭṭhiyā sati brahmacariyavāso na hoti || ||
sn12.35:3.5: Ete te bhikkhu ubho ante anupagamma majjhena Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti || || 6
sn12.35:4.1: Katame nu kho bhante saṅkhārā kassa ca panime saṅkhārāti || ||
sn12.35:4.2: No kallo pañhoti Bhagavā avoca || || Katame saṅkhārā kassa ca panime saṅkhārāti iti vā bhikkhu yo vadeyya || aññe saṅkhārā aññassa ca panime saṅkhārāti iti vā bhikkhu yo vadeyya || ubhayam etam ekatthaṃ vyañjanam eva nānaṃ || ||
sn12.35:4.3: Tam jīvaṃ tam sarīranti vā bhikkhu diṭṭhiyā sati brahmacariyavāso na hoti ||
sn12.35:4.4: aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti vā bhikkhu diṭṭhiyā sati brahmacariyavāso na hoti || ||
sn12.35:4.5: Ete te bhikkhu ubho ante anupagamma majjhena Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti || ||
sn12.35:5.1: Avijjāya tveva bhikkhu asesavirāganirodhā yānissitāni visūkāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni kānici kānici || || 15
sn12.35:5.2: Katamaṃ ca jarāmaraṇaṃ kassa ca panidaṃ jarāmaraṇam iti vā || aññaṃ jarāmaraṇam aññassa ca panidaṃ jarāmaraṇam iti vā || || Taṃ jīvaṃ tam sarīram iti vā aññaṃ jīvam aññam sarīram iti vā || ||
sn12.35:5.3: Sabbānissitāni pahīnāni bhavantī || ucchinnamūlāni tālavatthu katāni anabhāvakatāni āyatiṃ anuppādadhammāni || ||
sn12.35:6.1: Avijjāya tveva bhikkhu asesavirāganirodhā yā nissitāni visukāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni kānici kānici || || 16
sn12.35:6.2: Katamā jāti kassa ca panāyam jāti iti vā || || Tam jīvaṃ taṃ sarīram iti vā aññam jivam aññaṃ sarīram iti vā || ||
sn12.35:6.3: Sabbānissitāni pahīnāni bhavanti || ucchinnamūlāni talavatthukatāni anabhāvakatāni āyatiṃ anuppādadhammāni ||
sn12.35:7.1: Avijjāya tveva bhikkhu asesavirāganirodhā yā nissitāni visukāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni kānici kānici || || 17
sn12.35:8.1: Avijjāya tveva bhikkhu asesavirāganirodhā yānissitāni visūkāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni kānici kānici || || 25
sn12.35:8.2: Katame saṅkhārā kassa ca panime saṅkhārā iti vā || || Aññe saṃkhārā aññassa ca panime saṅkhārā iti vā || taṃ jivaṃ taṃ sarīram iti vā aññaṃ jivam aññaṃ sarīram iti vā || ||
